title: git kura seal claim — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura seal claim --json <path...>`, nested under the common envelope's data field. seal claim is all-or-nothing: either all paths are processed or none are.

currentKey.description: The key derived from the current managed worktree.

status.description: claimed: path was newly claimed. already-owned: path was already claimed by the current key (idempotent).
